name: Back squat
cues: Brace before you unrack.
Sit between your hips.
Drive the floor away.

name: Front squat
cues: Keep the elbows high.
Stay tall through the middle.
Stand up fast.

name: Trap-bar deadlift
cues: Push your hips back.
Take the slack out of the bar first.
Finish tall, do not lean back.

name: Romanian deadlift
cues: Hinge, do not squat.
Keep the bar against your legs.
Stop when your hamstrings run out.

name: Goblet squat
cues: Hold the bell against your chest.
Sit straight down.
Keep your heels flat.

name: Bulgarian split squat
cues: Most of your weight on the front foot.
Drop straight down.
Keep your ribs down.

name: Walking lunge
cues: Step out, not down.
Keep your torso upright.
Push through the whole front foot.

name: Lateral lunge
cues: Push your hips back as you step out.
Keep the trailing leg straight.
Both feet stay flat.

name: Step-up
cues: Drive through the top foot.
Do not push off the floor.
Lower under control.

name: Hip thrust
cues: Tuck your chin.
Finish with your ribs down.
Squeeze at the top for a full second.

name: Nordic curl
cues: Lower as slowly as you can.
Keep your hips straight.
Catch yourself with your hands.

name: Single-leg Romanian deadlift
cues: Hips square to the floor.
Reach the free leg back.
Stop before your back rounds.

name: Cossack squat
cues: Sit into one hip.
Keep the straight leg heel down.
Move slowly at the bottom.

name: Barbell bench press
cues: Set your shoulder blades before you unrack.
Touch the same spot every rep.
Push yourself away from the bar.

name: Dumbbell bench press
cues: Keep your wrists stacked.
Lower until your elbows pass your ribs.
Press the bells slightly together.

name: Overhead press
cues: Squeeze your glutes before you press.
Move your head back, then through.
Finish with the bar over your ears.

name: Push-up
cues: One straight line from head to heels.
Elbows at about 45 degrees.
Push the floor away.

name: Pull-up
cues: Start from a dead hang.
Pull your elbows to your ribs.
Chin over the bar, no kipping.

name: Chin-up
cues: Palms towards you, hands shoulder width.
Lead with your chest.
Lower all the way down.

name: Dumbbell row
cues: Keep your back flat.
Pull to your hip, not your shoulder.
Do not twist to finish the rep.

name: Inverted row
cues: Body in one line.
Touch your chest to the bar.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top.

name: Face pull
cues: Pull to your forehead.
Lead with your elbows.
Finish with your thumbs back.

name: Pallof press
cues: Do not let the band turn you.
Press straight out from your chest.
Breathe through the hold.

name: Dead bug
cues: Press your low back into the floor.
Move the opposite arm and leg.
Exhale as you reach.

name: Side plank
cues: Stack your hips and shoulders.
Push the floor away.
Keep breathing.

name: Copenhagen plank
cues: Squeeze the bench with the top leg.
Keep your hips high.
Start with the bottom knee down.

name: Heavy slow calf raise
cues: Three seconds up, three seconds down.
Full stretch at the bottom.
Do not bounce out of the bottom.

name: Single-leg calf isometric
cues: Rise to the top and hold.
Keep the ankle stacked over the toes.
Stop the set if it starts to shake.

name: Spanish squat isometric
cues: Let the band hold your knees back.
Sit to about 90 degrees.
Keep your shins vertical.

name: Isometric squat hold
cues: Hold at about 90 degrees.
Push the floor apart.
Keep your weight in the middle of your foot.

name: Eccentric calf lowering
cues: Up on two legs, down on one.
Take five seconds to lower.
Let the heel drop below the step.

name: Pogo hops
cues: Stay tall and stiff through the ankles.
Off the ground fast.
Do not let your heels touch.

name: Submaximal countermovement jump
cues: About three quarters effort.
Same arm swing every rep.
Land quiet, knees tracking out.

name: Jump test
cues: Same warm-up, same shoes, same hands every week.
Take off and land inside the field.
Land with your legs extended, the way you took off.

name: Depth jump
cues: Step off, do not jump off.
Minimum time on the ground.
Stop the set when the contact gets slow.

name: Hurdle hop
cues: Knees up, feet cycling under you.
Land and leave in one beat.
Keep your chest up.

name: Box jump
cues: Jump up, do not just tuck up.
Land soft in the same shape you left.
Step down, never jump down.

name: Standing broad jump
cues: Swing your arms hard.
Reach forward with your hips.
Stick the landing before you reset.

name: Single-leg bound
cues: Cover ground, do not go up.
Drive the free knee through.
Stop if you cannot hold the landing.

name: Tuck jump
cues: Knees to your hands.
Land where you left.
Keep the ground time short.

name: Trap-bar jump
cues: Light bar, fast bar.
Jump, do not press the floor slowly.
Reset every rep from a dead stop.

name: Med-ball scoop toss
cues: Load your hips, not your back.
Throw up and back.
Every rep at full speed.

name: Rotational med-ball throw
cues: Turn from your back hip.
Let your front foot pivot.
Throw hard, catch the rebound calmly.

name: 5-10-5 shuttle
cues: Drop your hips before you plant.
Touch the line with the near hand.
Accelerate out of every turn.

name: 45-degree cut and sprint
cues: Plant with the outside foot.
Keep your shoulders over the plant.
Sprint five steps out of the cut.

name: 10 m acceleration sprint
cues: Push back, not down.
Stay low for the first three steps.
Full effort or stop the set.

name: 30 m sprint
cues: Build to tall and relaxed.
Do not reach with your feet.
Walk back for full recovery.

name: 40 m sprint
cues: Accelerate for 20 m, then run tall.
Hold top speed, do not strain.
Walk back for full recovery.

name: 90/90 hip switch
cues: Keep both knees at ninety.
Move from your hips, not your back.
Pause a beat on each side.

name: Couch stretch
cues: Squeeze the glute on the stretched side.
Keep your ribs down.
Breathe out into the stretch.

name: World's greatest stretch
cues: Drop the back knee.
Reach the elbow to the floor, then rotate up.
Follow your hand with your eyes.

name: Foam rolling
cues: Move slowly, about an inch a second.
Pause on the sore spots.
Keep breathing, do not brace.

name: Glute bridge
cues: Push through your heels.
Finish with your ribs down.
Hold the top for two seconds.

name: Banded lateral walk
cues: Stay low the whole set.
Keep tension on the band.
Do not let your knees fall in.

name: A-skip
cues: Tall through the hips.
Strike under your body.
One beat per skip.

name: Wall ankle mobilization
cues: Keep the heel down.
Drive the knee over the little toe.
Move to the edge of the stretch, not past it.

name: Thoracic rotation
cues: Turn from the ribs, not the low back.
Exhale at the end of each turn.
Keep your hips still.

name: Box squat
cues: Sit back to the box, do not drop onto it.
Stay tight while you are on the box.
Drive the floor away without rocking.

name: Jump squat
cues: Light bar, fast bar.
Jump, do not grind out of the bottom.
Reset your brace every rep.

name: Barbell jump
cues: Keep the bar light and the bar fast.
Extend hips, knees and ankles together.
Land the way you took off.

name: Seated jump
cues: Sit tall, then go with no dip.
All of the effort is upward.
Reset fully between reps.

name: Depth pause jump
cues: Step off, do not jump off.
Hold the bottom for a full second.
Then jump as high as you can.

name: Approach jump
cues: Two or three steps, no more.
Plant hard and go straight up.
Stop the set when the height drops.

name: Quick-contact jump
cues: Off the ground as fast as you can.
Stiff ankles, quiet landing.
Stop when the contact gets slow.

name: Countermovement jump test
cues: Same arm swing every attempt.
Dip to the same depth every attempt.
Three attempts, the best one counts.

name: Countermovement jump check
cues: Same arm swing and the same dip every attempt.
Three attempts, the best one counts.
It is a reading, not a session: stop at three.

name: Reactive hop check
cues: Five hops, stiff ankles, minimum time on the floor.
Read the reactive strength index off the device.
Three attempts, the best one counts.

name: Squat jump
cues: Start from a held half squat.
No dip, just go up.
Land soft and reset.

name: Weighted pull-up
cues: Open hand, no crimping on the bar.
Start from a dead hang every rep.
Stop the set before the last rep gets slow.

name: Weighted pull-up cluster
cues: Clusters: one rep, rest about 20 seconds, repeat.
Open hand, no crimping on the bar.
Every rep starts from a dead hang.

name: Explosive pull-up
cues: Open hand, no crimping on the bar.
Pull as fast as you can move.
Stop the set when the speed drops.

name: Band-assisted overspeed pull
cues: Set the band so it only helps at the bottom.
Open hand, no crimping on the bar.
Every rep as fast as you can move.

name: Open-hand hangboard hang
cues: Open hand only, never a full crimp.
Shoulders engaged, not hanging off the joints.
End the hang before the grip starts to slip.

name: Med-ball chest throw
cues: Push the ball, do not lob it.
Full arms at the finish.
Every rep at full speed.

name: Seated med-ball throw
cues: Sit against the wall so your back cannot help.
Throw flat and hard.
Three attempts, the best one counts.

name: Med-ball overhead slam
cues: Reach tall, then drive the ball down.
Let your hips do the work.
Every rep at full speed.

name: Med-ball rotational throw
cues: Turn from your back hip.
Let your back foot pivot.
Throw hard on both sides.

name: Push press
cues: Short dip, no bend at the waist.
Drive with your legs, finish with your arms.
Bar over your ears at the top.

name: Dumbbell press
cues: Ribs down before you press.
Press slightly back, not forward.
Lower under control every rep.

name: Band knee-alignment split squat
cues: Let the band pull your knee in, then refuse it.
Knee tracks over the middle of your foot.
End the set when the knee starts to drift.

name: Band knee-alignment step-down
cues: Let the band pull your knee in, then refuse it.
Tap the floor, do not land on it.
End the set when the knee starts to drift.

name: Open-hand pull-up
cues: Open hand, no crimping on the bar.
Start from a dead hang.
Pull your elbows down to your ribs.

name: Open-hand dumbbell row
cues: Hold the bell in your fingers, not a fist.
Row to your hip, not your chest.
Keep your back flat.
